note: Maintainer decision 13: every delivered entry pins the full originals it relies on. The entry is otherwise the minimal loadable one (variant, column, versions, evidence, noted). The allowed twin is every build case with an [[errata.delivered]] entry, which carries the pin; its stale twin is errata-delivered-stale-when-the-documented-definition-drifts.
